facts.text: Jon expressed that dancing is a way for him to express himself and find his happy place.

evidence.quote: Dancing for me is like a way to express myself and find my happy place.

facts.text: Jon mentioned that he used to be scared of what people would think about him but learned that his own happiness is the most important thing.

evidence.quote: I used to be scared to death of what people would think, but I learnt that my own happiness is the most important thing.

facts.text: Gina recalled dance classes and shared a photo of a group of young women in ballet attire, which brought back memories for her.

evidence.quote: I used to love spending time in the studio. That photo looks awesome, brings back lots of memories.

facts.text: Gina shared a photo of a trophy from a dance contest, which serves as a reminder of the hard work, dedication, and joy that dance brings.

evidence.quote: Here's one of my trophies from a dance contest, nice reminder of the hard work, dedication and joy it brings.
